CleanupConfig.description: Cleanup stage settings (module 5): when the LLM pass runs, and figure descriptions.
CleanupConfig.title: CleanupConfig

DocFigure.description: One figure of a document with every article it is attached to (the Verify re-attach picker).
DocFigure.title: DocFigure

EvidenceRef.description:
A span quoted from a named source. `verified`: the span occurs (whitespace collapsed) in
that source's text; an unverified span is kept and shown struck through.
EvidenceRef.title: EvidenceRef

EvidenceSource.description: Where a proposal's evidence span was quoted from (module 10).
EvidenceSource.title: EvidenceSource

ExportStatus.description:
`unlocked` is the raw gate (no open flag, no queued in-scope block); `blockers` are the
blocks an active override does not cover: an export is possible iff `blockers` is empty.
ExportStatus.title: ExportStatus

ExportSummary.description: What the Export screen shows after an export (SPEC 7.4).
ExportSummary.title: ExportSummary

GroupOverride.description: A human regrouping decision, appended to docs/<slug>/group_overrides.json.
GroupOverride.title: GroupOverride

GroupingParams.description: Every grouping constant, frozen into groups.json so a result can be explained.
GroupingParams.title: GroupingParams

GroupsFile.description:
docs/<slug>/groups.json: both views of one document, the accounting of blocks that sit in
no group, and the provenance needed to explain or reproduce the result.
GroupsFile.title: GroupsFile

LearningConfig.description:
Self-improvement settings (module 7). `enabled` off means baseline behaviour exactly,
even when learned state exists on disk. `use_global` / `contribute_global` opt in to the
cross-project store ($MANUALLABOR_HOME/learning).
LearningConfig.title: LearningConfig

PriorAttempt.description:
An earlier round of the same flag. `reason` is the reviewer's rejection reason; the
model's own rationale is shown to the reviewer but never fed back to the model.
PriorAttempt.title: PriorAttempt

RequestIn.description: Body of mutations that carry nothing but an idempotency key.
RequestIn.title: RequestIn

VisionReading.description:
A vision model's transcript of a block's numbers (module 10). It carries no score and no
confidence by design: it is an attester for number changes and a pane in the Agent screen,
never a signal.
VisionReading.title: VisionReading

get.description: Every figure of the document with all of its attachments (articles), sorted by figure id.

post.description: Rollback is activation of an earlier snapshot (design 07 section 9).

get.description:
Per-block type/status/numeric flag so the client can compute live counts (design 08 G1).
Statuses follow the current threshold; docs that are not scored yet are omitted.

post.description:
Approve / edit / flag / skip / back. An edit that fails the faithfulness check is a
409 `edit_conflict` carrying the diff; re-send with `confirm_content_change=true` to store
it as a human edit.

get.description: `view_threshold` is a view filter for this read only; it never approves anything.
